title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-91-24一模

items.zh: 这道菜趁热吃味道最好。
items.en: The dish tastes best when hot.

items.zh: 除了特效之外，这部电影的情节和演员的表演也可圈可点。
items.en: In addition to special effects, the plot and the actors’ performances are worth mentioning.

items.zh: 指望他帮助毫无意义，他也束手无策。
items.en: There is no point counting on him, for he himself is helpless.

items.zh: 她梦想记录祖国的壮丽风景,这激励她去探索自然中尚未被发现的角落，并通过摄影来保留那份美丽。
items.en: She dreams of capturing the magnificent landscapes of her motherland, which motivates her to explore the untouched corners of nature and preserve their beauty through photography.
